other_conditions: Applicant must be a rape victim woman or girl
Applicant may be a BPL woman saved from trafficking
Applicant may be an acid‑attack victim
Applicant may be a woman who has completed her prison sentence
Applicant may be a BPL woman who is abandoned or divorced
Applicant may be a girl or woman in distress residing in government or non‑government shelter homes, girls’ homes, maintenance homes, etc.
Applicant may be a dowry‑victim woman
Applicant may be a victim of child marriage
benefits_summary: Provides permanent skill‑development training across various domains to empower victimised women for self‑employment and livelihood.
